CREATE SCHEMA "model_15273b88e4204687"
CREATE TABLE "model_15273b88e4204687"."business"(id bigint PRIMARY KEY,balance bigint NOT NULL,active boolean NOT NULL,region text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,version uuid NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "model_15273b88e4204687"."state"(key bigint PRIMARY KEY,version uuid,present boolean NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "model_15273b88e4204687"."candidates"(version uuid PRIMARY KEY,key bigint NOT NULL,predecessor uuid,action text NOT NULL,old_present boolean NOT NULL,new_present boolean NOT NULL,image jsonb)
CREATE TABLE "model_15273b88e4204687"."effects"(LIKE "model_15273b88e4204687"."candidates" INCLUDING ALL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON "model_15273b88e4204687"."effects"(predecessor) WHERE predecessor IS NOT NULL

CREATE FUNCTION "model_15273b88e4204687"."predecessor"(v uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY INVOKER SET search_path=pg_catalog AS $model$DECLARE n integer; p uuid; BEGIN SELECT count(*),min(predecessor::text)::uuid INTO n,p FROM "model_15273b88e4204687"."candidates" WHERE version=v; IF n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'predecessor not unique'; END IF; RETURN p; END$model$

CREATE FUNCTION "model_15273b88e4204687"."delete_token"(k bigint,p uuid) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY INVOKER SET search_path=pg_catalog AS $model$DECLARE n integer; v uuid; BEGIN SELECT count(*),min(version::text)::uuid INTO n,v FROM "model_15273b88e4204687"."candidates" WHERE key=k AND predecessor=p AND action='DELETE'; IF n<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'delete not unique'; END IF; RETURN v; END$model$
